claims.statement: For each prime p, a minimum-order counterexample to cyclic subgroup TPP among all finite p-groups has nonpowerful Frattini subgroup and d(Frattini(P)) <= 3.
claims.scope: Necessary condition on a minimum unrestricted counterexample, not an inequality for every group with powerful Frattini subgroup.

claims.statement: If Frattini(H) is powerful for every H <= P, then every cyclic subgroup TPP triple in the finite p-group P has factor-order product at most |P|.
claims.scope: Uniform for the specified subgroup- and quotient-closed class; direct Sylow-product analogue for finite nilpotent groups.

claims.statement: SmallGroup(64,90) has a generating cyclic TPP triple of orders 4,4,4, in three independent Frattini directions, with |ABC|=48 rather than 64.
claims.scope: An exact single witness. Independence of three generating directions does not justify global injection.

computation.proof_boundary: Single exact witness only. The uniform powerful-group proof is a written proof using the retained primary results, not a finite census or full Lean formalization.
